table.name: TLGNS_SAP_CONTRACT
table.description: Contains the header-level attributes and - together with tlgns_sap_contract_item etc - represents a Contract as received from SAP via the Contracts/STPO interface. The 'normal' Contracts (for outgoing deliveries, pickup) as well as the STPO (Stock Transfer Purchase Order, i.e. similar to LOGON IUD/IUP) are stored in this table. Only fields relevant for LOGON are imported into this table; additional fields can be added when required by additional functional specification.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ID
column.description: PK. Technical ID given by LOGON DB when object is created, based on a sequence.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_NO
column.description: SAP Contract Number as received from SAP. (Origin:VBAK.VBELN / E1EDK01.belnr)

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_contract_type_bs. Contract type as distinguished by SAP (e.g. ZCQ=Agreement with customer with fixed prices, ZCF=Agreement with customer without prices fixed, etc). Not all types in SAP lead to different behaviour in LOGON. (Origin: VBAK.auart / EKKO.bsart - /sales_document_notification/document_header_organizational_data/BSART

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_sarea. Sales Area of this contract. (Origin: Sales organization (VBAK.VKORG), Distribution channel (VBAK.VTWEG), Division (VBAK.SPART) as received from SAP, mapped to LOGON sarea table.). XSD origin: E1EDK14.orgid.qualf.002, 007, 006

column.name: SOLDTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Soldto (Auftraggeber) to which this contract belongs. Characteristics of the soldto (normal, 1-time-soldto) may influence the usage of this contract.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Shipto (Warenempfaenger) for which the contract is valid. Special cases: Generic shipto (=contract valid for all shipto's of this soldto); 1-time shipto (=location not fixed), i.e. address must be entered during order taking.

column.name: BILLTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Billto (Rechnungsempfaenger) for orders created from this contract. If set: This billto is the default billto to be used in the orders. If not set: Selectable in Ordertaking by the usual LOGON mechanisms.

column.name: PAYER_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Payer (Rechnungszahler) for orders created from this contract. If set: This payer is the default payer to be used in the orders. If not set: Selectable from all payers associated with this BP (tlgns_sap_bp_pf_payer)

column.name: VALID_FROM_DAT
column.description: Valid-from date as received from SAP. 1.1.1970=no start date / since ever. (Origin: VBAK.GUEBG / E1EDK03.datum.iddat.019)

column.name: VALID_UNTIL_DAT
column.description: Valid from date as received from SAP. 31.12.9999=forever. (Origin: VBAK.GUEBG / E1EDK03.datum.iddat.020)

column.name: VALID_UNTIL_IGNORE_FLAG
column.description: Flag to define if valid_until can be ignored. Flag is not changeable in LOGON, but only in SAP. (Origin: TBD. For now, always 0 in LOGON.)

column.name: SAP_SHIPPING_COND_CD
column.description: Shipping condition, e.g.E1=Truck, S1=SBB, ... (Origin: VBAK.VSBED / E1EDK01.vsart)

column.name: CUST_PURCHASE_ORDER_NO
column.description: Contract/Purchase number as known to the customer. (Origin: VBAK.BSTNK / E1EDK02.bstzd.qualf.001)

column.name: ITEM_GROUPING_TYPE
column.description: Grouping type applied for the contract items during sap import, meaning a different contract_item generation method. Should not change during the lifecycle of a contract. Values: 0 (unknown) - for contracts already in the database at the time of introducing this field, and no possibility to achieve which type was applied (but known: quantity restricted or advance payment); 1 (no grouping) - no group leader for the contract items; 2 (quantity restricted) - every contract item has its own group leader, whose quantity is a limitation: it cannot be exceeded in order taking; 3 (advance payment) - 1 group leader for many payments (sap contract items), with a limitation: sum of quantities cannot be exceeded in order taking

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency of the contract; only for cash-sales orders based on this contract. (Origin: VBAK.WAERK / E1EDK01.curcy)

column.name: CREDIT_CONTROL_AREA_CD
column.description: Credit Control Area. For future use in LOGON.

column.name: CREDIT_LIMIT_ACCOUNT_NO
column.description: Customer's account number with credit limit reference. Credit limit check must be done against this customer. For future use in LOGON.

column.name: CUSTOMER_CREDIT_GROUP
column.description: Customer Credit Group. For future use in LOGON.

column.name: CREDIT_MANAGEMENT_GROUP
column.description: Credit representative group for credit management. For future use in LOGON.

column.name: CREDIT_RISK_CATEGORY
column.description: Credit management: Risk category. For future use in LOGON.

column.name: CREDIT_CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency to use for credit checks (no functionality currently in LOGON)

column.name: SALES_DISTRICT_CD
column.description: Sales district. Should be the same as the sales district of the soldto. Store anyway in LOGON, possibly for future use. (Origin: VBKD.BZIRK / E1EDK14.orgid.qualf.022)

column.name: INCOTERMS_CD
column.description: Incoterms of this order. It is used in the case of the Fenics weighingsystem interface, and it determines allowed delivery types for the contract per sarea.

column.name: VALIDATION_CODE
column.description: Sap contract validation code. No usage in LOGON, stored for future use. Value is used as an authorization code to create an order n within the weighing system application (FENICS). (Origin PINCODE)

column.name: VENDOR_SAP_NO
column.description: Vendor partner function of the contract. Simple text field: stored as received, no foreign key in Logon. (It does not need to be treated as a normal Vendor or Carrier.) Sent back to SAP in the transfer 'inbound' delivery request (and only there) the information about the vendor. No logic attached in Logon. (Origin: /document_header_partner_information/PARTNR if received with /document_header_partner_information/PARVW value 'LF'.)

column.name: VAT_NO_MANDATORY_FLAG
column.description: LOGON receives in the Contract interface a flag which indicates if it is mandatory to send the VAT Number to SAP for the one-time ship-to This flag is received in field /sales_document_notification/document_header_general_data/pricing_related_info/ZVATM. If true: VAT number is required to be specified for each order taken for that contract and ship-to.

column.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_payment_method_bs. Payment method of the contract; used in LOGON to be displayed on the Cash Sales Invoice. The SAP field is E1EDK01-ZTERM.

column.name: CONTROLLER_NO
column.description: Controller number; no logic in logon. Used in delivery note printing for export invoice (Serbia)
